0-source-1.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 of the European Parliament and of the Council on digital operational resilience for the financial sector (DORA)
0-source-1.applicability: Applies to financial entities within the EU financial sector as defined in Article 3, establishing framework for ICT risk management, incident handling, and oversight responsibilities

passages.text: Financial entities should follow the same approach and the same principle-based rules when addressing ICT risk taking into account their size and overall risk profile, and the nature, scale and complexity of their services, activities and operations.

In order to maintain full control over ICT risk, financial entities need to have comprehensive capabilities to enable a strong and effective ICT risk management, as well as specific mechanisms and policies for handling all ICT-related incidents and for reporting major ICT-related incidents.

0-source-2.title: Regulatory Technical Standards on ICT risk management framework and on simplified ICT risk management framework
0-source-2.applicability: Specifies requirements for standard and simplified ICT risk management frameworks under DORA Articles 5 and 16, applicable to financial entities based on size, risk, and complexity

passages.text: The RTS identify the key elements that financial entities subject to the simplified regime and of lower scale, risk, size and complexity would need to have in place, setting out a simplified ICT risk management framework.

concerns.description: Determine whether a financial entity must apply proportionality principles to ICT risk management based on its size, risk profile, and operational complexity.
Verify if a financial entity qualifies for the simplified ICT risk management framework due to being a microenterprise or having lower scale, risk, size and complexity.
Confirm management body accountability for establishing comprehensive ICT risk management capabilities including incident handling and oversight.
